limitations: Development/regression cases, not a sealed unseen test.
Only CPU lexical attachment retrieval and context/tokenizer packing were tested.
Historical per-case prompt budgets and scorer definitions are retained; retention rates are descriptive collection statistics, not a controlled comparison.
Old conflicts are authored Evidence controls; new conflicts pass through native TXT parsing.
Strict native unit binding is measured only in the five extra numeric cases; legacy numeric checks are not equivalent.
Source-grounded questions are project-authored, not official QA annotations.
No model accuracy, full hybrid-RAG, Planner, OCR or production latency claim.
